extracted.name: Air-fryer brussels sprouts
extracted.description: Cook sprouts in an air fryer for a super-easy cooking method, then add flavourings of your choice, such as chilli or chopped crispy bacon
ingredient_lines: chopped cooked bacon chilli flakes or chopped roasted hazelnuts, to serve (optional)
instruction_lines: Heat the air fryer to 180C. If using fresh sprouts, trim them, then tip in a bowl. Drizzle over the oil, season well and toss to coat. Arrange the sprouts in the air-fryer basket in a single layer and cook for 10-15, tossing halfway through.

If cooking from frozen, tip the frozen sprouts into the air-fryer basket and cook for 10-15 mins, depending on how golden you like them. Remove, then tip onto a serving plate and scatter with any of the suggested toppings, if you like.
